[1/2] Keystone testbed cycle: cover MeshBuilder quad/box composition, mesh merging, matrix normals and skinned concatenation

impact_assessment.why: MeshBuilder composes primitives and merged geometry but the shooter testbed has no direct coverage of its mode rules, UV/color/normal handling or skin concatenation.
impact_assessment.benefits: Five tests pin quad/box counts and bounds, add_mesh scaling/color products, inverse-transpose normals, skinned joint/inverse-bind agreement and plain-vs-skin mode errors.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: temp meshes only; no game/sim/hash change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Small in-memory meshes, full suite, determinism and project gates.

[1/2] Keystone testbed cycle: cover atomic byte/JSON writes, backups, BOM reads and failure cleanup

impact_assessment.why: serialization is the crash-resilience layer behind saves/reports but the shooter testbed has no direct coverage of binary writes, backup chaining or temp cleanup on replace failure.
impact_assessment.benefits: Five tests pin binary atomic replacement, JSON backup/default-off behavior, non-finite rejection, BOM reads and temp cleanup when the target is a directory.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: temp files only; no game/sim/hash change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Temp paths per test, no monkeypatching, full suite, determinism and project gates.
